$$7x+28=7x+k$$
In the given equation, $k$ is a constant. The equation has infinitely many solutions. What is the
value of $k$ ?

A line segment that has a length of 113 centimeters $(\mathrm{cm})$ is divided into three parts. One part is 47
$\mathrm{cm}$ long. The other two parts have lengths that are equal to each other What is the length, in $\mathrm{cm}$,
of one of the other two parts of equal length?

The expression $7 x 6+9 x 6 - 8 x 6$ is equivalent to $b x 6$ , where $b$
is a constant. What is the value of $b$ ?

A real estate company offers a series of three webinars. 1,250 people attended the first webinar:
$46\%$ of the people who attended the first webinar attended the second webinar, and $32\%$ of the

people who attended the first and second webinars attended the third webinar. How many people
attended all three webinars?

To study fluctuations in leaf water potential, samples of wood were taken from 22 trees and cut in
the shape of a cube. The length of the edge of one of these cubes is 3.000 centimeters. This cube
has a density of 0.250 grams per cubic centimeter. What is the mass of this cube, in grams?

Note: Figure not drawn to scale.

For the right circular cone shown, $B$ is a point on the circumference of the base, and the length of
segment $AB ($not shown) is 32 centimeters. If the height of the cone is 16 centimeters and the
volume of the cone is $k\pi$ cubic centimeters, what is the value of $k$?

If $2 ( 4 - 5 x )+7 ( 4 - 5 x )+9=8 ( 4 - 5 x )+6$, what is the value of $5 x$ −
4 ?

In the given equation, $p\gt 1$ and $t\gt 1$. If $t=p2n-1$,where $n$ is a constant, what is the value of $n$?

$$7x2(4x-13)(4x-u)=0$$
In the given equation, $u$ is a positive constant. The sum of the solutions to the equation is 13.
What is the value of $u$ ?

Right rectangular prism $X$ is similar to right rectangular prism $Y$. The surface area of right
rectangular prism $X$ is 59 square centimeters $( c m 2 )$ , and the
surface area of right rectangular prism $Y$ is 1 , $475 c m 2$ . The volume of
right rectangular prism $Y$ is 1,500 cubic centimeters $( c m 3 )$ .
What is the sum of the volumes, in $c m 3$ , of right rectangular prism $X$ and right
rectangular prism $Y$?

The function $f$ is defined by $f ( x )=a b x/n$ , where $a$, $b$, and $n$ are constants, and
$b$ and $n$ are integers. If $f ( 2 )=6$ and $f ( 5 )=162$, what is the value of $f ( 7 )$ ?
